coverage: All 28 scenes: named cast, speaking minor roles, supernatural figures, named cultural references and relevant groups. Generic crowds, pronouns, places and unnamed hypothetical figures are excluded.

entities.name: Macbeth
entities.body: A Scottish nobleman and soldier, known as the Thane of Glamis. Lady Macbeth’s husband.

snapshots.body: A Scottish nobleman holding the titles Thane of Glamis and Thane of Cawdor. Lady Macbeth’s husband.
King of Scotland and Lady Macbeth’s husband.

entities.name: Lady Macbeth
entities.body: Macbeth’s wife.

entities.name: Banquo
entities.body: A Scottish commander and Macbeth’s fellow soldier. Father of Fleance.

entities.name: Fleance
entities.body: Banquo’s young son.

entities.name: Macduff
entities.body: A Scottish nobleman, the Thane of Fife. Lady Macduff’s husband.

entities.name: Duncan
entities.body: King of Scotland and father of Malcolm and Donalbain.

snapshots.body: Scotland’s former king; father of Malcolm and Donalbain.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.body: Duncan’s elder son and Donalbain’s brother.

snapshots.body: Duncan’s elder son, now acclaimed king of Scotland. Donalbain’s brother.

entities.name: Donalbain
entities.body: Duncan’s younger son and Malcolm’s brother.

entities.name: The three witches
entities.body: The three supernatural women, also called the Weird Sisters.

entities.name: First Witch
entities.body: One of the three witches, distinguished by her numbered speaker label rather than a personal name.

entities.name: Second Witch
entities.body: One of the three witches, distinguished by her numbered speaker label rather than a personal name.

entities.name: Third Witch
entities.body: One of the three witches, distinguished by her numbered speaker label rather than a personal name.

entities.name: Ross
entities.body: A Scottish nobleman who carries news between the other characters.

entities.name: Angus
entities.body: A Scottish nobleman, accompanying Ross when he brings news to Macbeth.

entities.name: Lennox
entities.body: A Scottish nobleman at the royal court.

entities.name: Menteith
entities.body: A Scottish nobleman among the commanders opposing Macbeth.

entities.name: Caithness
entities.body: A Scottish nobleman among the commanders opposing Macbeth.

entities.name: Lady Macduff
entities.body: Macduff’s wife and the mother of the boy in the scene at their home.

entities.name: Macduff’s son
entities.body: The young son of Macduff and Lady Macduff.

entities.name: Siward
entities.body: An English commander and the earl of Northumberland. Father of Young Siward.

entities.name: Young Siward
entities.body: Siward’s son, a young soldier in the army opposing Macbeth.

entities.name: Seyton
entities.body: An attendant serving Macbeth at Dunsinane.

entities.name: The porter
entities.body: The gatekeeper at Macbeth’s castle.

entities.name: The wounded soldier
entities.body: The wounded soldier who reports the battle to Duncan. Also addressed as Captain.

entities.name: The old man
entities.body: The elderly man speaking with Ross outside Macbeth’s castle.

entities.name: The gentlewoman
entities.body: An attendant to Lady Macbeth.

entities.name: The Scottish doctor
entities.body: The physician attending Lady Macbeth at Dunsinane.

entities.name: The English doctor
entities.body: The physician at the English king’s court. A different doctor from the one at Dunsinane.

entities.name: The Thane of Cawdor
entities.body: A Scottish nobleman who holds the title Thane of Cawdor.

snapshots.name: The former Thane of Cawdor
snapshots.body: The Scottish nobleman whose title of Thane of Cawdor is transferred to Macbeth.

entities.name: Macdonwald
entities.body: A rebel leader fighting against King Duncan.

entities.name: Sweno
entities.body: The Norwegian king whose army fights Duncan’s forces.

entities.name: Sinel
entities.body: Macbeth’s father, from whom he inherited the title Thane of Glamis.

entities.name: King Edward
entities.body: The English king, Edward the Confessor, at whose court Malcolm finds refuge.

entities.name: Graymalkin
entities.body: The First Witch’s familiar spirit, taking the form of a cat.

entities.name: Paddock
entities.body: The Second Witch’s familiar spirit, taking the form of a toad.

entities.name: Harpier
entities.body: The familiar spirit called by the Third Witch. The passage does not describe its form.

entities.name: Hecate
entities.body: A goddess associated with witchcraft.

snapshots.body: The goddess who presides over the witches and their magic.

entities.name: Bellona
entities.body: The Roman goddess of war.

entities.name: Neptune
entities.body: The Roman god of the sea.

entities.name: Belzebub
entities.body: A name for the devil, invoked in the porter’s joke about keeping the gates of hell.

entities.name: The Gorgon
entities.body: A monster of Greek mythology whose face turns those who look at it to stone.

entities.name: Fortune
entities.body: Luck imagined as a female power favoring one side or another.

entities.name: Banquo’s ghost
entities.body: The apparition of Banquo seen by Macbeth at the banquet.

entities.name: The armed head
entities.body: The first apparition called up by the witches: a head wearing armor.

entities.name: The bloody child
entities.body: The second apparition called up by the witches: a child covered in blood.

entities.name: The crowned child
entities.body: The third apparition called up by the witches: a crowned child carrying a tree.

entities.name: The eight kings
entities.body: The line of crowned figures shown to Macbeth by the witches.

entities.name: The vision of Banquo
entities.body: The figure of Banquo accompanying the line of kings in the witches’ vision.

entities.name: First Murderer
entities.body: One of the men Macbeth engages for a secret task.

entities.body: One of the men Macbeth engages for a secret task.

entities.name: Third Murderer
entities.body: One of the men Macbeth engages for a secret task.

entities.name: The murderers
entities.body: The men whom Macbeth engages for a secret task.

entities.body: One of the men who enter Lady Macduff’s home.

entities.name: The intruders at Macduff’s home
entities.body: The group of men who enter Lady Macduff’s home.

entities.name: The Scottish lord
entities.body: The unnamed nobleman speaking with Lennox about Scotland.

entities.name: The court lords
entities.body: The noblemen gathered at the Scottish court.

entities.name: The messenger at Inverness
entities.body: The messenger speaking to Lady Macbeth at Inverness.

entities.name: The messenger at Fife
entities.body: The unnamed messenger who comes to Lady Macduff.

entities.name: The lookout at Dunsinane
entities.body: The lookout who reports to Macbeth at Dunsinane.

entities.body: The servant accompanying Macbeth with a torch.

entities.name: The palace servant
entities.body: The servant attending Macbeth at the palace.

entities.name: Lady Macbeth’s servant
entities.body: The servant attending Lady Macbeth in this scene.

entities.name: The servant at Dunsinane
entities.body: The servant who brings Macbeth news of the approaching army.
